prompt: What is the sum of all two-digit whole numbers that are divisible by 7?
trap_note: The two-digit multiples of 7 run from 14 to 98, that is 7x2 through 7x14, summing to 7 x 104 = 728. Starting the series at 7 itself adds a one-digit number and gives 7 x 105 = 735 -- an off-by-one at the boundary rather than in the arithmetic, so every step of the working checks out.
